text: At Chernobyl, a lid weighing at least a thousand tonnes was blown up through the roof. In a few seconds, the reactor's power spiked to many times its normal level. The fuel shattered, and the cooling water flashed into steam, all at once, with nowhere to go. The pressure burst the fuel channels, and the steam explosion lifted the reactor's massive steel lid. A second explosion followed, scattering burning graphite. The fire burned for days. And it started with the shutdown button. Full video on my channel.
